tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL Condition as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All Other relevant conditions are as per tender document
Annual turn over certificate for last year -2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN Numbe
Anti-collusion and self declaration certificate regarding not black listed by any firm/ Government agencies
Attested copy of the Certificate of registration in the GST Professional tax registration certificate
Attested copy of the Certificate of registration in the Provident Fund and ESI and last 3 month ESI , PF payment receipt

Attested copy of the Income Tax return filed by the Service Provider for the last Three years financial years from last five financial years in the Income Tax Department and the clearances received if any 2021-22 to 2025-26
Attested copy of the new Certificate of registration in the Labour Department

Certificate by Chartered Accountant for the Annual Turnover of Rs.6.52 Lakhs relating to providing outsource personnel for the each of the last three audited financial years from last five financial years 2021-22-21 to 2025-26 with Balance sheet, Profit & Loss A/c
Liquid assets and availability of credit facility of no less than 1.67 lakhs Credit line Letter of Credit Certificate from Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc Unconditional Bankers Certificate
Satisfactory service completion certificate from any Government organization ULB minimum Two Nos of operators for one year -2021-22 to 2025-26

The company firm should have been in the business of providing 50 Percentage Similar manpower services for last three financial years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26 to any Government offices in Karnataka Govt. undertaking organization in Karnataka Details of past performance on services of similar nature executed by the Service Provider in the format hereunder provide documents in support of the claim
The Firm should have ISO Certificate no. 9001 issued by competent authority
